To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a new method for SfM that combines deep learning with explicit constraints, and that this new method is able to produce state of the art results on a variety of datasets.
we propose a novel architecture, namely Deep Structure from Motion (DeepSFM), for the first time that can jointly optimize depth and pose estimation in a single network.
we propose a novel deep learning framework, namely DeepSfm, to tackle the SfM problem.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel deep architecture for SfM. The main contributions are as follows.
the problem of Structure from Motion (SfM).

the following three contributions: (1) we propose a new physical driven deep network, which is inspired by traditional BA, to tackle SfM; (2) we design a novel cost volume based architecture to explicitly model structural constraint; (3) we conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our model is a promising alternative to existing SfM methods, which achieves superior performance on both depth estimation and pose estimation.
DeepSFM, with the physical driven architecture and cost volume based design, achieves the state-of-art performance on both structure and motion estimation with superior robust against noise in input.
DeepSFM is an effective and robust model for SfM, which achieves the state-ofthe-art performance on depth and pose estimation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DeepSFM is the first deep learning model which can handle SfM in an end-to-end manner.
we are the first to introduce the idea of deep learning based BA to SfM and achieve the state-of-the- art performance.
we design a deep learning model for SfM, which achieves the state-of-art performance with superior robustness, and the design is inspired by the traditional BA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
explicit structural constraints are essential to improve the performance of SfM.
, by explicitly incorporating the physical constraints into neural network, we can achieve better performance than the purely learning-based models.
the physical driven design can help deep learning models to better exploit the structural constraints, and achieve better performance.
